all_items.name: Horizontal tail servo
all_items.notes: Placed at the horizontal stabilizer geometric center until a measured installation location is supplied.

all_items.name: Vertical tail servo
all_items.notes: Placed at the vertical stabilizer geometric center until a measured installation location is supplied.

all_items.name: Landing gear
all_items.notes: Installed directly below the main-wing leading edge, with its center 4 inches below the wing plane.

all_items.name: Fuselage structure
all_items.notes: Fuselage-local uniform shell-area-density approximation from the forward-most electronics/payload edge to the aft-most edge; mass scales with length and cross-sectional perimeter.

all_items.name: Battery
all_items.notes: Equivalent fat electronics-area CM, packed inside the fuselage before airplane installation.

all_items.name: Motor
all_items.notes: Equivalent fat electronics-area CM, packed inside the fuselage before airplane installation.

all_items.name: Propeller
all_items.notes: Equivalent fat electronics-area CM, packed inside the fuselage before airplane installation.

all_items.name: ESC
all_items.notes: Equivalent fat electronics-area CM, packed inside the fuselage before airplane installation.

all_items.name: Other electronics
all_items.notes: Equivalent fat electronics-area CM, packed inside the fuselage before airplane installation.

all_items.name: Sensor release mechanism
all_items.notes: Permanent mechanism modeled as a point mass at the top of the center container stack; mass is 1/20 of sensor mass.

all_items.name: M2 sensor shipping container
all_items.notes: Mass includes a sensor-equivalent payload plus the 0.5 lb empty container. The center bay fills 3-wide and 2-high before paired aft/forward bays are filled alternately.

all_items.name: M3 sensor
all_items.notes: Three-inch-diameter sensor centered inside the volume formerly occupied by the primary M2 sensor container, with cylindrical intrinsic inertia. Its length is derived from the M3 flown weight and cannot exceed the M2 container envelope.
